title: Evolve the diagram: every new box answers a named flaw
caption: Start with the simplest thing that works, then add one box per unmet requirement or number.

steps.text: v1 is client → service → database. It meets the functional requirements and nothing else.
Hold it against the non-functional requirements and your estimates: peak QPS, data size, latency, availability.
Something fails, e.g. 17k reads/s on one database. Add exactly one box that fixes it (a cache) and say which number forced it.
Then check the new version again. New boxes bring new flaws.
Nothing unmet: stop drawing and move to the deep dives. Extra boxes without a reason count against you.
